title: August and the Cover
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Theo Blackwood, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
